title: Fred Posner
html:
Fred has been involved in Kamailio for more than 10 years, especially in the activities involving the promoting of the project, presenting about it at many conferences world wide.

He is located in Florida, USA, and besides offering RTC consultancy services for Kamailio, Linux and other open source projects via The Palner Group, Fred runs a family bakery, where the famous Kamailio cookies are baked.
